_doc: Items & recipes. use: stat effects when eaten/used directly. tool: not consumed. contraband: confiscated in raids and when you get caught. Recipe needs: ids consumed (an array inside means any one of them), bonus: used if you have them, tool: required not consumed, illegal: cooking it counts as the cooking offence while the smell lingers.

garri.name: Garri (Ijebu)
garri.desc: The national boarding house currency. Soak am, drink am, survive am.

sugar.name: Sugar
sugar.desc: Sugar cubes. You fit lick am raw if wahala too much.

milk.name: Sunrise Milk (powder)
milk.desc: Lick am straight from sachet — the forbidden joy.

milo.name: Strongman Cocoa
milo.desc: The most borrowed item in the history of boarding school.

kuli.name: Kuli-kuli
kuli.desc: Hard like stone, sweet like victory.

cornflakes.name: Cornflakes
cornflakes.desc: Dry chop or with milk. Either way, e sweet.

indomie.name: Kwik Noodles
indomie.desc: Crunch am raw like biscuit or soak am if you get flask.

biscuits.name: Cream Crackers
biscuits.desc: Dry. Very dry. Dey drink water follow.

gala.name: Jolly Roll
gala.desc: Sausage roll and soft drink — but there is no soft drink here.

chinchin.name: Chin chin
chinchin.desc: Mummy fry am herself. Hide am from Senior.

bread.name: Bread
bread.desc: Agege bread. Soft today, stone tomorrow.

sardine.name: Sardine
sardine.desc: Titus. Make bread-and-sardine and become king for one night.

cornedBeef.name: Corned beef
cornedBeef.desc: Big man protein. If senior see am, e don go.

pringles.name: Crunchos
pringles.desc: Half the hostel never see this thing before.

pureWater.name: Pure water
pureWater.desc: Bite the corner, squeeze am finish in one breath.

zobo.name: Zobo
zobo.desc: Tuck shop zobo — ginger fit wake the dead.

soap.name: Bathing soap
soap.desc: One bar = 5 baths. Used automatically when you baff.

detergent.name: Detergent (Washwell)
detergent.desc: One sachet = 5 washes. Used automatically when you wash clothes.

cream.name: Body cream
cream.desc: Menthol rub, petroleum jelly or shea butter — make your skin shine for inspection.

torch.name: Torchlight
torch.desc: For reading after lights out, and finding your slippers at 2am.

flask.name: Flask (hot water)
flask.desc: Fill am at the kitchen. Hot cocoa at night = luxury.

padlock.name: Padlock
padlock.desc: Protects your locker. Thieves go cry.

water.name: Bucket of water
water.desc: Fetched from the borehole. Bathe with am, soak garri with am, or carry am go give senior.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.desc: Every boarding student's best friend. Fetch water, bathe, wash.

mosquitoNet.name: Mosquito net
mosquitoNet.desc: Sleep without mosquito concert. Better rest at night.

cutlass.name: Cutlass
cutlass.desc: For general labour. Clear your plot twice as fast.

heater.name: Immersion heater
heater.desc: CONTRABAND. Boils water in 2 minutes. Cooking in the hostel = big wahala if dem catch you.

novel.name: Pacesetters novel
novel.desc: Borrowed from the library. Read am for morale — or under your desk in class.

lessonNotes.name: Lesson notes
lessonNotes.desc: The brilliant kid's neat notes. Studying with them gives +50% knowledge.

pastQuestions.name: Past questions
pastQuestions.desc: Old exam papers. +1 hint in every test and exam.

examPaper.name: Leaked exam questions
examPaper.desc: The real exam questions. +2 hints in exams. If they find am on you… expulsion matter.

sickChit.name: Sick bay chit
sickChit.desc: A signed excuse slip. The next class you miss won't count as truancy.

exeat.name: Exeat form
exeat.desc: A blank signed exeat. Show the gateman to jump the fence without wahala once.

panadol.name: Paracetamol
panadol.desc: For headache, malaria, heartbreak — Nigerian students believe it cures everything.

cookedFood.name: Plate of jollof
cookedFood.desc: Proper cooked food. Not dining hall food. Real food.

meat.name: Meat
meat.desc: Big, shining meat. Somebody go dey look for this one.

letter.name: Love letter
letter.desc: Sealed with petroleum jelly and hope.

evidence.name: Stolen wrappers
evidence.desc: Empty Strongman sachets with other people's names. Proof.

stinkBomb.name: Stink bomb
stinkBomb.desc: Lab chemicals in a vial. Somebody go suffer.

slamBook.name: Slam book
slamBook.desc: Pass it round so friends answer questions about themselves (and you). Open it from 🎒 → ✍️ Writing.

kola.name: Kola nut
kola.desc: Bitter, wakes you up. Old men love it — Mallam Musa especially.

soakGarri.name: Soak Garri
soakGarri.desc: Garri + water (+ sugar, milk, groundnut if you get). The boarding house national dish.
line: You soak garri, the thing swell like your future. 🥣
Garri, sugar, groundnut — Michelin star no reach this one.
You drink the garri water last. Na the best part.

hotMilo.name: Hot cocoa
hotMilo.desc: Cocoa powder + hot water from flask (+ milk, sugar). Pure therapy.
line: You make thick cocoa, the kind wey spoon fit stand inside. ☕
The aroma reach the next corner. Two people suddenly become your friend.

breadSardine.name: Bread & Sardine
breadSardine.desc: Royal meal. Lock the door before you make am.
line: Bread and sardine. You chop am like person wey dey hide from EFCC. 🥪

softIndomie.name: Soaked noodles
softIndomie.desc: Kwik Noodles soaked in flask water. No be cooking, na survival.
line: You cover am with exercise book for 3 minutes. E soft. E sweet. 🍜

noodles.name: Cooked noodles
noodles.desc: Kwik Noodles + water + heater. Proper cooked noodles. ILLEGAL — the smell go travel.
line: The heater hum, the noodles dance for cup. Seasoning smell reach the next hostel. 🍜
Cooked noodles for boarding house. You be king tonight. 🍜

heaterTea.name: Boiled tea
heaterTea.desc: Heater + water (+ Strongman, milk, sugar). Illegal but heavenly.
line: You boil water with heater and make tea like Oga for office. ☕

garriSandwich.name: Bread & groundnut
line: Bread and groundnut. Crunchy, filling, legal. 🥪
